title: Discovering history
text: An incredible tour, Granada keeps the history of Spain in its streets and it was a pleasure to discover them with Isa.

title: Incredible.
text: Excellent tour of Granada; the guide Andrés was friendly and answered any questions, in addition to making the experience pleasant and fun. I would do it again without a doubt every time I go to Granada.
